text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Jungle Pocket wasn't feeling well, so I had her rest in the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Can't be helped, guess I'll take a nap.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? Where am I? Backstage...?

text_block_list.name: Male Host
text_block_list.text: And it's kicking off again this year—the tournament to decide Japan's funniest manzai duo, the UM-1 Grand Pliiiix!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! L-Let's do our best, Pokke-chan!
Aim for Comedy Champion, okay!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Dantsu? Wait, "do your best"...
Don't tell me I'm running?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What are you saying~!?
We practiced our routine so hard together
just for this day!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you super fired up too, Pokke-chan?!
This year's judge is that charismatic
entertainer herself—Fuji Kiseki-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Whoa, whoa, whoa! Are you for real!?
Fuji-san was watching our comedy routine...!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Then we can't be lookin' lame!
Let's get out there and make 'em roar with laughter!"

text_block_list.name: Male Host
text_block_list.text:
Man, it's really heating up again this year~!
Now then, the next comedy duo is—

text_block_list.name: Female MC
text_block_list.text:
Entry number 918—
It's "Jungle & Flame"!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hello, we are 'Jungle & Flame'!
I'm Dantsu Flame, and this is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Time for a quick gag, here goes!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
!? P-Pokke-chan, that's not how the bit goes!
Did you forget the punchline...!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Rock, paper, scissors—
Here's a spirited Rock!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, um... Yes, exactly!
She's my partner, a real spunky horse girl!
Just the other day—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And from there...!
The Raging Lion Stance!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? Ummm...
Right, Pokke-chan loves animals~!
Come to think of it, when we went to the zoo—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And finally! Spread your arms and legs...
Make a giant character for "Big"!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Geeez! You're way too unhinged, Pokke-chan!
This is a manzai competition, you know!?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahhahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Fuji-san is smiling!
Dants, keep going and make her burst out laughingâ

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it was a dream...? Hehe,
I can't believe she smiled like that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to having a good dream,
Jungle Pocket was able to get
back into top shape.
